title: The anatomy of a search term
intent: Second in the anatomy series. A conversion looks like demand until you take it apart: the report's own numbers stack up, and the bottom layer is a competitor's brand name. Built on the 2026-09-09 Omega search-terms audit. No client, competitor or supplier is named on screen. Drafted for internal review. Not client work, not scheduled, not published.

plateSource.provenance: Supplied by Dillon 2026-09-09 as visual direction. Licence NOT verified. Confirm before any use outside Momentum.

factCheck._rule: Every on-screen number is measured and sourced below. No client, competitor or supplier is named on screen.
factCheck._source: 12_Brain/07_Reviews/2026-09-09 - Omega search terms, first audit.md — Google Ads account 285-398-1364, Search terms report, read live in-browser 2026-09-09, range 2026-04-01 to 2026-09-08.
factCheck.6 CONVERSIONS: Audit table row 1: the top search term by clicks recorded 6.00 conversions.
factCheck.$26.87 EACH: Same row: $161.22 cost over 6.00 conversions = $26.87 cost per conversion. Stated verbatim in the audit.
factCheck.A RIVAL'S NAME: Same row: the term is a competing landscaping company's brand name. Named in the vault, deliberately not named on screen.
Audit: 'It is not. It is people looking for a different company.' Pattern-level, no number attached.
Audit, opening line: 'The search-terms report had never been run on this account. It was run on 2026-09-09.'
